name: Şube Gelir Tablosu
query:
SELECT
    h.account_type as "Hesap Grubu::150",
    h.hesap_adi as "Hesap Adı::250",
    
    /* BAKİYE HESAPLAMA */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            /* Gelirler (Alacak - Borç) */
            WHEN h.account_type LIKE 'Gelir%%' OR h.account_type LIKE 'Income%%' 
            THEN (IFNULL(gl.alacak, 0) - IFNULL(gl.borc, 0))
            
            /* Giderler (Borç - Alacak) */
            ELSE (IFNULL(gl.borc, 0) - IFNULL(gl.alacak, 0))
        END
    ) as "Tutar:Currency:150"

FROM
    `tabHesap` h

LEFT JOIN
    `tabMuhasebe Defteri` gl 
    ON gl.hesap = h.name 
    AND gl.firma = h.firma
    
    /* KRİTİK NOKTA: ŞUBE FİLTRESİ JOIN İÇİNDE */
    AND gl.sube = %(branch)s

WHERE
    (h.account_type LIKE 'Gelir%%' OR h.account_type LIKE 'Income%%' 
     OR h.account_type LIKE 'Gider%%' OR h.account_type LIKE 'Expense%%')
    
    AND h.firma = %(company)s
    
    AND gl.tarih >= %(from_date)s
    AND gl.tarih <= %(to_date)s

GROUP BY
    h.name

ORDER BY
    h.account_type DESC, 
    3 DESC
